item.description:
# Clasp 0.1.7
- One Universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 13.3 or later. - Clear drag-to-Applications installer and a first-install guide on the Clasp website. - Verified Sparkle update packaging using Clasp's existing update-signing key. - Existing Clips and settings remain stored separately from the app.
This is an ad-hoc-signed, unnotarized alpha. Apple has not verified it. Only approve opening it if you trust its source. Manual app replacement remains available if automatic updating fails.
